title: Finite diagram arrows and relations lift after object models are chosen
statement: Let $I$ be a nonempty directed preorder and $D:I^{\mathrm{op}}\to\mathrm{Sch}$ a system of qcqs schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] with affine transition maps [pqf-def-affine-morphism], with limit cone $(X,\pi)$. Let $A$ be a finite quiver with finitely many generating arrows, $\mathrm{Paths}(A)$ its free category, $R$ a finite set, and $p_r,q_r:s_r\to t_r$ paths. Let $F:\mathrm{Paths}(A)\to\mathrm{Sch}/X$ satisfy $F(p_r)=F(q_r)$. Fix $i\in I^{\mathrm{op}}$, finite-presentation models $V_a\to D_i$ (locally of finite presentation, quasi-compact and quasi-separated), and isomorphisms $\alpha_a:(V_a)_X\simeq F(a)$, where subscript denotes pullback [def-pc-fibre-product]. Then there are $j$, $h:j\to i$, a functor $G:\mathrm{Paths}(A)\to\mathrm{Sch}/D_j$ and a natural isomorphism $G_X\simeq F$, with $G(a)=(V_a)_j$ for every $a$ and $G(p_r)=G(q_r)$ for every $r$. No etaleness or object-descent assertion is included.

proof.text: Conjugate the finitely many generating arrows of F by the supplied alpha_a. Apply 01ZM (2) to each resulting map between pullbacks of V_a. Choose a common refinement of these stages and i, using directedness; base-change the maps there.

Transport the generating arrows through the canonical iterated-pullback identifications, so their objects are exactly the pullbacks of the prescribed V_a. Extend the quiver map using Paths.lift. The supplied comparisons are natural on generators, hence on every path by induction (identity paths use identity maps, and concatenation uses functoriality).
For each r, naturality and F(p_r)=F(q_r) imply equality of the two composites after limit pullback. Apply 01ZM (3) to those maps and choose a common refinement of the finitely many relation stages.

Base-change the functor to the common relation stage; functoriality preserves every relation. Transport this functor along objectwise canonical pullback-composition isomorphisms to obtain objects literally equal to the direct pullbacks of V_a, and transport its natural comparison at the same time. Empty vertex, arrow and relation sets impose no stage choices; use i or the current stage.

lean.statement: theorem finite_diagram_lift_of_models {I : Type u} [Preorder I] [IsDirected I (· ≤ ·)] [Nonempty I] (D : Iᵒᵖ ⥤ Scheme.{u}) [∀ {i j : Iᵒᵖ} (f : i ⟶ j), IsAffineHom (D.map f)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, CompactSpace (D.obj i)] [∀ i : Iᵒᵖ, QuasiSeparatedSpace (D.obj i)] (c : Cone D) (hc : IsLimit c) (A : Type v) [Finite A] [Quiver.{v} A] [Finite (Σ a b : A, Quiver.Hom a b)] (R : Type v) [Finite R] (s t : R → Paths A) (p q : ∀ r, s r ⟶ t r) (F : Paths A ⥤ Over c.pt) (i : Iᵒᵖ) (V : A → Over (D.obj i)) (hV : ∀ a, LocallyOfFinitePresentation (V a).hom ∧ QuasiCompact (V a).hom ∧ QuasiSeparated (V a).hom) (α : ∀ a, (Over.pullback (c.π.app i)).obj (V a) ≅ F.obj a) (hR : ∀ r, F.map (p r) = F.map (q r)) : ∃ (j : Iᵒᵖ) (h : j ⟶ i) (G : Paths A ⥤ Over (D.obj j)) (β : G ⋙ Over.pullback (c.π.app j) ≅ F), (∀ a, G.obj a = (Over.pullback (D.map h)).obj (V a)) ∧ (∀ r, G.map (p r) = G.map (q r))
